packageCommands.name: build:public-reference
packageCommands.command: npm --workspace @openlup/core run build && npm --workspace @openlup/platform run build && npm run guard:client-secret-boundary && npm run guard:public-reference-site-routes && npm run build:public-reference:client && npm run build:public-reference:ssr && npm run build:public-reference:prerender

packageCommands.name: lint
packageCommands.command: node scripts/ast-grep/check-filewide-ignore.mjs && ast-grep scan --error=no-suppress-all --error=unused-suppression && ast-grep test --skip-snapshot-tests && eslint .

packageCommands.name: prelint
packageCommands.command: npm --workspace @openlup/core run build && npm --workspace @openlup/outbox run build && npm --workspace @openlup/platform run build

packageCommands.name: pretest
packageCommands.command: npm --workspace @openlup/core run build && npm --workspace @openlup/outbox run build && npm --workspace @openlup/platform run build

packageCommands.name: test:scoped
packageCommands.command: scope_file=$(mktemp) && trap 'rm -f "$scope_file"' EXIT && export OPENLUP_VITEST_EXCLUDE_FILE="$scope_file" && node scripts/ci-test-scope.mjs && npm test
